protocol.scope: M0 fixed-event-aligned F8 trajectory audit only; no adaptive/restart or new controller admitted.

ledger.noninterference: bitwise equality at all common stored states
ledger.events: all actual nonzero wall updates; no all-particle iteration-history tensor
ledger.transfer: GPU reduction and sparse event compaction; flush per accepted save interval; rejected interval separately retained

STEP_SENSITIVE.definition: norm of 10/5us gate YZ difference >50nm (the unchanged F8 minimum effect)

WALL_CORRECTION_SIGNIFICANT.definition: abs(cumulative fixed32 mean signed Z wall displacement) >50nm

CONTACT_SENSITIVE.definition: abs(cumulative fixed32 mean signed Z pair-contact displacement) >50nm; excludes untested indirect rearrangement effects

TRANSVERSE_EFFECT_RESOLVED.definition: Y2 positive gate +Z increments vs BOTH Y0 and Y1 exceed max(50nm,3*(step sensitivity of Y2 + comparator)); does not imply target reached

conditional_runs.Y2_10us: only after Y1 ledger identifies the mechanism and an active-control comparison remains needed
conditional_runs.Y2_5us: only if Y2 fine-step signed components are needed to bound wall sensitivity
conditional_runs.window_5_2p5us: only if localized discrepancy and exact complete-state restart semantics can be demonstrated
